_comment: English strings for the gameplay keys. A list is a pool: the game picks one by seed, never the same line twice in a row. {name} is filled in. All texts are placeholders (TODO(initiator)). #131 turns this into checked localisation tables.

job.first_haul.brief: Three crates of fizzy mud for Bent Spoon. They fizz less if you don't drop them.
track.standing_courier_office.name: standing with Dinglepost Couriers
track.standing_small_family.name: standing with the Gribbles
job.family_errand.title: A small favour
job.family_errand.brief: Two crates of fizzy mud, no questions.
commodity.parcel.name: wobbly parcel
location.lint_trap.name: Lint Trap
location.noodle_post.name: Noodle Post
location.pebble_kiosk.name: Pebble Kiosk
job.courier_lint_trap.title: A parcel for the Lint Trap
job.courier_lint_trap.brief: One wobbly parcel to the Lint Trap, just down the path.
job.courier_noodle_post.title: Noodles by hand
job.courier_noodle_post.brief: Two wobbly parcels to the Noodle Post. They are warm. Do not ask why.
job.courier_pebble_kiosk.title: The pebble rush
job.courier_pebble_kiosk.brief: Three wobbly parcels to the Pebble Kiosk before the timer wins.
briefing.reason.commodity.parcel: The parcel is wobbly. Do not shake it, do not stir it.
Wobbly parcels hate being late and being dropped, in that order.
Nobody knows what is in it. That is the charm.
commodity.sock_dust.name: sock dust
commodity.grumble_jelly.name: grumble jelly
location.slosh_wholesale.name: Slosh & Daughter Wholesale
track.standing_wholesaler.name: standing with Slosh & Daughter
job.customer_order.title: A customer's order
job.customer_order.brief: Goods from the wholesaler for a customer who is waiting.
giver.wholesaler.name: Slosh & Daughter Wholesale
giver.wholesaler.greet.first: Wholesale, retail, and everything in between. Mostly in between.
New? Everything on the shelf is legal. Technically.
Hello! Please do not feed the jelly.
giver.wholesaler.greet.regular: The usual? We have a usual for you.
Back again. The jelly missed you.
Good timing: the sock dust is fresh.
giver.wholesaler.greet.failure: We heard about the last order. The jelly heard too.
A customer called. Several times. Loudly.
Let us make this one go better. For the jelly's sake.
giver.wholesaler.intro: Orders are up on the board.
giver.wholesaler.reason: It is on the house. The house disagrees.
giver.wholesaler.signoff: Bring the empties back. Do not bring the empties back.
customer.mabel_snood.name: Mabel Snood
customer.mabel_snood.order: Mabel Snood: my socks are out of dust again.
Mabel Snood says the dust is for a very serious project.
Mabel Snood wants dust. Do not ask for what.
customer.mabel_snood.thanks: Mabel Snood sniffs the dust and smiles.
Mabel Snood: you may come again.
Mabel Snood adds you to the good list.
customer.mabel_snood.grumble: Mabel Snood: this dust has been stepped on.
Mabel Snood writes you on the other list.
Mabel Snood sighs in four languages.
customer.captain_pip.name: Captain Pip
customer.captain_pip.order: Captain Pip: the jelly crew is restless.
Captain Pip needs jelly before the tide of nonsense turns.
Captain Pip: jelly, and none of your excuses.
customer.captain_pip.thanks: Captain Pip salutes with the wrong hand. High praise.
Captain Pip: shipshape, in a way.
Captain Pip names a puddle after you.
customer.captain_pip.grumble: Captain Pip: the jelly is mutinying.
Captain Pip points at the horizon, meaningfully.
Captain Pip will be telling the harbour about this.
customer.moss_committee.name: The Moss Committee
customer.moss_committee.order: The Moss Committee demands mud, in triplicate.
The Moss Committee has voted for more mud.
The Moss Committee: mud, and the minutes will show it.
customer.moss_committee.thanks: The Moss Committee approves, unanimously, twice.
The Moss Committee moves to thank you. Seconded.
customer.moss_committee.grumble: The Moss Committee notes your failure in the minutes.
The Moss Committee is disappointed, formally.
The Moss Committee will table this. Loudly.
notice.order.placed: {customer} has an order. Check the wholesaler.
location.skyhook_school.name: Skyhook Flight School
track.licence_flight.name: flight licence
track.standing_flight_school.name: standing with Skyhook Flight School
licence.flight.name: Flight licence
job.flight_exam.title: Flight licence exam
job.flight_exam.brief: Take off, fly to the Drip Rock pad, land on it gently and set the school's crate down. The ship is lent for the exam.
giver.flight_school.name: Skyhook Flight School
giver.flight_school.greet.first: Want to fly? Everybody wants to fly. Few want to land.
Welcome to Skyhook. Our motto: up is optional, down is mandatory.
A new pilot! The ship is lent for the exam. It is the only one we have, so please keep it whole.
giver.flight_school.greet.regular: Licensed and still coming by? We like that.
Back for the honours? Soft hands, soft landing.
giver.flight_school.greet.failure: The ship is fine. Mostly. Let us try again.
Everybody crashes once. Some twice. Half price for the second.
The ground was there the whole time. Remember that.
giver.flight_school.intro: The exam is short, the lesson is long.
Listen carefully, then ignore half of it.
giver.flight_school.reason: Without a licence the seat refuses you. It has opinions.
A licence makes you a pilot, on paper.
The crate is part of the test. It is also fragile.
giver.flight_school.signoff: Up, over, down. In that order.
Mind the ground. It is closer than it looks.
notice.exam.passed: LICENCE PASSED: you may fly. Do not let it go to your head.
EXAM PASSED. The seat now knows you.
PASSED. You are a pilot, officially.
notice.exam.honours: PASSED WITH HONOURS! The school is moved to tears, a little.
HONOURS! A soft landing and a good time. Show-off.
EXAM PASSED, HONOURS. The seat purrs.
notice.exam.failed: Not this time. The retry costs {retry}.
The ground won. Try again for {retry}.
notice.licence.needed: The seat refuses: you need the flight licence. Take the exam at Skyhook Flight School.
No licence, no seat. Skyhook Flight School gives exams.
The seat says no. Ride along, or go and pass the exam at Skyhook.
giver.courier_office.name: Dinglepost Couriers
giver.courier_office.greet.first: New face! We always need a new face. The old ones keep quitting.
Welcome to Dinglepost. The coffee is mud. So is the cargo.
You look employable. That is rare around here.
giver.courier_office.greet.regular: Back again! Management is almost proud.
The reliable one. Our insurance company hates you.
Good to see you. The crates missed you.
giver.courier_office.greet.failure: About last time. We will not talk about last time.
The crates are still crying. Let us do better.
One more chance. Management is counting. Slowly, but counting.
giver.courier_office.intro: Listen closely, I will say this once and then again.
giver.courier_office.reason: The customer is waiting. The customer is always waiting.
It is urgent. Everything is urgent. This one more so.
Do not ask what is inside. It is mostly mud.
giver.courier_office.signoff: Off you go. Walk briskly, not heroically.
giver.small_family.name: The Gribbles
giver.small_family.greet.first: Sit. You have a face we might remember.
Come in, come in. Mind the dog. It is not a dog.
So you are the new one. Aunt Mabel has opinions.
giver.small_family.greet.regular: Again you. Good. The soup is still warm.
giver.small_family.greet.failure: Disappointing. Uncle Bort cried a little.
We spoke about you at dinner. Not kindly.
Careful, now. We have long memories and short tempers.
giver.small_family.intro: It is only a tiny task. Tiny.
giver.small_family.reason: It is a gift. For someone who will not be thanking us.
Do not ask. Aunt Mabel says asking is rude.
giver.small_family.signoff: Go. The soup is getting cold.
briefing.title: {title} for {giver}
{giver} needs: {title}
{title} ({giver})
briefing.shape.few: {amount} crates of {commodity}, {from} to {to}. Not far, not hard.
briefing.shape.many: A big one: {amount} crates of {commodity}, {from} to {to}.
{amount} crates of {commodity} from {from} to {to}. Bring a strong back.
briefing.shape.timed: {amount} crates of {commodity}, {from} to {to}, and the clock is running.
{from} to {to} with {amount} crates of {commodity}. Hurry. The mud is not getting younger.
Quick: {amount} crates of {commodity} from {from} to {to} before the timer wins.
briefing.reason.commodity.fizzy_mud: The mud must stay fizzy, so go easy on the corners.
Fizzy mud goes flat when you rush it. Do not rush it.
briefing.reason.route.dusty: The dust out there makes everyone grumpy, so be early.
Bent Spoon is dusty and impatient.
Dust makes people thirsty and cranky. Deliver before they notice.
briefing.reason.route.wet: Drip Rock is damp and the staff are unhappy about it.
It rains indoors over there. Hurry.
notice.job.accepted: You said yes to {title}. No refunds.
{title} is yours now. Try not to lose it.
notice.job.expired: Too slow: {title} ran out of time.
{title} expired. The mud waits for nobody.
notice.job.failed: Nothing arrived for {title}. The customer sighs.
notice.job.abandoned: {title} abandoned. The crates are now decoration.
notice.job.crate_lost: One crate fewer. It was not insured.
Crate lost. It had a good life.
notice.refused.too_many: Two jobs at a time is plenty.
Your hands are full of jobs.
notice.refused.not_available: Not yet. Come back when you are someone.
They do not know you well enough.
